name: meridian-usage
description: Local MCP connector for Meridian AI usage, cost, top users, and capability governance.

tools.name: usage_summary
tools.description: Summarize Claude and Gemini usage and cost for an authorized group and period.

tools.name: top_users
tools.description: Return the highest token users for an authorized group and period.

tools.name: capability_status
tools.description: Show current capability states for an authorized group.

tools.name: set_capability
tools.description: Persist an authorized capability override for a group.
